t: superbrightled.com reviews | Jeep Wrangler Forum
s: Look at the spec sheets to see what you're getting, and you need at least the following to compare apples to apples: 1- efficacy ( lumens per watt) and total power input 2- light throw pattern 3- color temperature ( should be 5000K for automotive application ) 4 - rated lifespan 5- warranty info Bottom line is that unless you're buying a known American or Canadian made LED lamp ( like one from Cree), then most of the rest of the marketplace is filled with East Asian cheap stuff.
